title: citeproof — repeat-run AI visibility reports for local-service agencies
oneLiner: For small local-marketing agencies, it runs each client's buyer prompts many times on the agency's own API keys and sends a white-label report with mention rates, confidence ranges, competitors named instead and cited sources, with raw answers kept as evidence.
overlaps: none in David's portfolio (closest: the factory's other agency tools, leakcheck and patchwell, both passed). In the market: ThriveStack citedby, Rankability, LocalSeen, Otterly, Peec.
